blockers.criterion: AC8: the project settings screen shows an error message beside the field on a refused save; invalid text remains available for correction.
blockers.reason: At lines 166-169 the form expects api.editSettings to return {ok:false, errors}, but the settings route returns HTTP 400 and api.call throws ApiError for every non-2xx response. The catch at line 200 sets only the general errors; loopsError stays empty, so the adjacent message at line 289 never appears. Submit abc through the real form and API client with a 400 validation response; assert that the whole-number message appears beside Review loop limit and that abc stays in the input. Do not mock api.editSettings as resolving {ok:false}, which hides this bug.

missingTests.criterion: AC5: with the run option empty, a run started through the server API uses the file value.
missingTests.reason: web/test/review-loop-limit.test.ts only parameterizes the successful start with 5; neither it nor the other feature tests sends an empty override through the start route. Add a case with a committed project maxLoops of 1 and SDLC_REVIEW_MAX_LOOPS set to an empty string, start through HTTP, and verify the child resolves 1 and the project configuration bytes remain unchanged. A manual check recorded in Markdown does not supply the required automated API test.

missingTests.criterion: AC8: Run page Review options show the Review loop limit field with the project value, verified by UI tests where they exist.
missingTests.reason: The new web/test/review-loop-limit-findings.test.ts supplies a real component-rendering test for Projects, but no test renders the Run Review options. Render Run with project maxLoops 3 and 0 and assert its loop-limit input and project-value hint show the corresponding value, including 0 rather than fallback 2. Exercise entering 5 and clearing the input and assert the start request carries the override and then uses the project value.
